checks.name: recipe_security_invariants
checks.detail: 6 destination-pinning mutations, all of which must be refused

comparisons.label: https->http downgrade in recipe[0].url
comparisons.note: RecipeSecurityError: recipe URL must use https, got http:// in 'http://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search'. Plaintext is refused outright rather than warned about: a recipe carries an API key, and there is no configuration under which sending it in the clear is the intended behaviour.

comparisons.label: lookalike host evil-geocoding-api.open-meteo.com against pinned geocoding-api.open-meteo.com
comparisons.note: RecipeSecurityError: recipe host 'evil-geocoding-api.open-meteo.com' is not 'geocoding-api.open-meteo.com' nor a subdomain of it. The URL is pinned at recipe creation and runtime inputs may populate declared body/query parameters only — never the host or the path.

comparisons.label: lookalike host evil-archive-api.open-meteo.com against pinned archive-api.open-meteo.com
comparisons.note: RecipeSecurityError: recipe host 'evil-archive-api.open-meteo.com' is not 'archive-api.open-meteo.com' nor a subdomain of it. The URL is pinned at recipe creation and runtime inputs may populate declared body/query parameters only — never the host or the path.

comparisons.label: templated url (host/path substitution)
comparisons.note: RecipeSecurityError: recipes[geocode].url contains a template placeholder: 'https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search/{path}'. The URL is PINNED at recipe creation — runtime inputs may populate declared body/query parameters only, never the host or the path. A substitutable URL is a destination

comparisons.label: undeclared threading input
comparisons.note: RecipeBookError: threading[1] supplies input(s) ['not_a_declared_param'] that recipe 'archive' does not declare in params_schema.properties (declared: ['end_date', 'hourly', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'start_date', 'timezone']). Runtime inputs may only populate DECLARED parameters.

comparisons.label: loopback destination (SSRF)
comparisons.note: RecipeSecurityError: recipe host resolves to 127.0.0.1 (loopback address space), which is refused. Reaching an internal service through a config-described call is the SSRF shape this fence exists to prevent.
